provenance.checked: inventory_ui.py --check compares every id with app/src/main/res (the generated repository/inventory-keepassdx.json); the screens marked harvested were read on the device
provenance.library: elements marked from: library are not in the app's own source (AppCompat, Material) and are verified on the device only
provenance.neverPress: Elements with `neverPress: true` change data or leave the app's safe state. A harvest or a test locates them but never taps them.

list.note: harvested. The toolbar: drawer, database name, Search, Sort, More options (a popup window with Save, Merge and Reload data).

sort.note: its tap did not open a dialog; the preferences file did not change

add_node.note: adds an entry or a group

drawer.note: harvested: the navigation drawer of the list. Settings is here, not in the overflow.

clear.note: the 'x' at the right end of the field, shown when it holds text: a tap clears the text. This is how the run empties the field; it never presses Backspace or Delete. Its id and description ('Clear query') are the search view's own (AppCompat), checked on the device, not in the app's source.

count.note: the number of results the app shows

close.note: a BACK ARROW at the left of the search bar (ic_baseline_arrow_back): it closes the search, it does not clear the text

entry.note: harvested. The fields are built at run time inside template_fields_container: their labels and values are text nodes WITHOUT ids (locate by label text, see Repository.value_after_label), and every field's Copy button is an unnamed ImageButton with the description Copy, in the order of the fields.

title_bar.note: its description is the entry's title

settings.note: harvested: the main screen and the categories App settings, Appearance, Form filling and Device unlocking. Every row is an AndroidX preference row (title, summary, icon, and for a switch a widget) inside recycler_view: the rows are located by their TITLE text. Rows seen: main: App settings, Form filling, Device unlocking, Appearance, Database settings, Security, Master key. App settings: General, Allow no master key, Delete password, Autosave database, Quick search, Keep screen on, Screenshot mode, User Verification. A category row is navigation; a row inside a category is a switch or a list and is NEVER tapped by a harvest.
